tasks.description: Create a self-onboarding process for new organizations, collecting organization name, subdomain/slug, and first administrator account details. This process provisions an empty, isolated tenant workspace and signs the first admin into it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new organization, when the onboarding process is completed, then a new tenant workspace is provisioned.
Given a new organization, when the onboarding process is completed, then the first admin is signed into the tenant workspace.

tasks.description: Implement a role-based access control system, allowing tenant admins to define custom roles and assign permissions. The system should ship with default roles (Admin and Member) and allow tenant admins to select from available permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when a custom role is created, then the role is added to the list of available roles.
Given a tenant admin, when a user is assigned a role, then the user's effective permissions are updated.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to invite new users by email and assign one or more roles to the invitation. The invitee should receive an email with a link to accept, set up their account, and join the tenant with the assigned roles.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when a new user is invited, then the invitee receives an email with a link to accept.
Given a tenant admin, when an invitation is accepted, then the new user is added to the tenant with the assigned roles.

tasks.description: Implement an immutable audit log to record significant actions within a tenant, including user invited, user removed, role changed, permission changed, billing plan changed, API key created or revoked, and settings changed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when a significant action is performed, then an entry is added to the audit log.
Given a tenant admin, when the audit log is viewed, then the log is displayed in a readable format.

tasks.description: Create a dashboard to display per-tenant usage metrics, including active users, API request volume, and storage consumed, over a selectable time range.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when the usage metrics dashboard is viewed, then the metrics are displayed in a readable format.
Given a tenant admin, when the time range is changed, then the metrics are updated accordingly.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to view the current plan, see current usage against plan limits, and upgrade or downgrade the plan.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when the current plan is viewed, then the plan details are displayed.
Given a tenant admin, when the plan is changed, then the new plan is applied.

tasks.description: Allow tenants to configure SAML-based single sign-on, capturing IdP metadata and enabling users to sign in via SAML.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when SAML is configured, then users can sign in via SAML.
Given a tenant admin, when SAML is disabled, then users cannot sign in via SAML.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to create named API keys scoped to their tenant, view the list of active keys, and revoke a key.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when an API key is created, then the key is added to the list of active keys.
Given a tenant admin, when an API key is revoked, then the key is removed from the list of active keys.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to toggle tenant-level feature flags to enable or disable optional product capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when a feature flag is toggled, then the feature is enabled or disabled accordingly.
Given a tenant admin, when the feature flags are viewed, then the current state of each flag is displayed.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to request an export of their tenant's data, generating the export asynchronously and making it available for download.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when a data export is requested, then the export is generated and made available for download.
Given a tenant admin, when the data export is downloaded, then the data is in a readable format.

tasks.description: Allow tenant admins to configure tenant-wide options, including organization display name, tenant subdomain/slug, default role assigned to new members, and default timezone.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when a setting is changed, then the new value is applied.
Given a tenant admin, when the settings are viewed, then the current values are displayed.

tasks.description: Ensure that no tenant can read or write another tenant's data, enforcing strict data isolation between tenants.
acceptance_criteria: Given two tenants, when one tenant attempts to access the other's data, then the access is denied.
Given two tenants, when one tenant attempts to modify the other's data, then the modification is denied.

tasks.description: Ensure that all admin actions are permission-gated via RBAC, preventing unauthorized access to sensitive features.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant admin, when an action is attempted without permission, then the action is denied.
Given a tenant admin, when an action is attempted with permission, then the action is allowed.

tasks.summary: Record Significant Mutations in Audit Log
tasks.description: Ensure that all significant mutations are recorded in the audit log, providing a tamper-evident record of changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a significant mutation, when the audit log is viewed, then the mutation is recorded.
Given a significant mutation, when the audit log is filtered, then the mutation is included in the results.

tasks.description: Ensure that the user invitation email is sent correctly, with a link to accept the invitation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user invitation, when the email is sent, then the email contains a link to accept the invitation.

tasks.summary: Migrate Existing Tenants to New Onboarding Process
tasks.description: Migrate existing tenants to the new onboarding process, ensuring a seamless transition for existing customers.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing tenant, when the migration is complete, then the tenant is using the new onboarding process.
Given an existing tenant, when the migration is complete, then the tenant's data is intact.

tasks.description: Create comprehensive API documentation, covering all endpoints and parameters.
acceptance_criteria: Given the API documentation, when a developer uses the API, then the documentation is accurate and helpful.

tasks.description: Ensure that all cross-cutting constraints are implemented, including strict tenant data isolation and permission-gated admin actions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a cross-cutting constraint, when the constraint is enforced, then the constraint is applied correctly.

tasks.summary: Add Unit Tests for Onboarding Process
tasks.description: Create unit tests for the onboarding process, ensuring that the process is thoroughly tested and validated.
acceptance_criteria: Given the onboarding process, when a unit test is run, then the test passes.

tasks.summary: Add Integration Tests for API Endpoints
tasks.description: Create integration tests for API endpoints, ensuring that the endpoints are thoroughly tested and validated.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API endpoint, when an integration test is run, then the test passes.

tasks.description: Create a load testing script to simulate high traffic and stress the system.
acceptance_criteria: Given the load testing script, when the script is run, then the system performs as expected under load.

tasks.description: Implement monitoring and alerting to detect and respond to system issues and errors.
acceptance_criteria: Given a system issue, when monitoring detects the issue, then an alert is triggered.
